This update was also given the name '''Trapper Update''', as this update added the [[Trapper]] tower. This update encompassed three updates, the main v1.14.0 update (released 24 February 2024) and two minor updates, the v1.14.0a (released 24 February 2024), v1.14.0b (released 1 March 2024) and
